species: Peptide sequences were searched against the C. auris subset of the UniProt database
sample_source: Both C. auris total protein and CWAP extracts were analysed, using Ca37 mAb as the primary antibody.
strain: Total protein and CWAP were extracted independently from C. auris CECT 13225, following the methodologies described by Areitio et al. and Pitarch et al., respectively.
